profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at CITY HOME
profile.summary: Passionate Staff Software Engineer specializing in developing innovative RESTful APIs and Microservices with expertise in Node.js, Express.js, Typescript, React.js, and MongoDB stack. Proficient in leveraging AWS Lambda for scalable solutions.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: React.js · Node.js · TypeScript · MongoDB · AWS Lambda · Express.js

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engaged in all phases of the software development lifecycle, responding to outages and building microservices API. Participate in design meetings and consult with the project managers to refine, test and debug web applications to meet business needs. Continuously integrated and deployed developed software. Updated the continuous integration/deployment scripts as necessary to improve continuous integration practices. Interact and sometimes direct third-party partners in the achievement of business and technology initiatives.
Project: Migration from Monolith into Microservices Architecture
Applied Technologies: Typescript, ECMAScript 6, Node JS, React JS, Next JS, API Restful, Micro-Services, NGINX, Mozu, Akeneo PIM, PHP 7 with Symfony MVC Framework, Unit Tests with Jest,  Google Tag Manager, Monetate, GitHub version controller, Jira, MySql Database, MongoDB database, Docker, Magento, Angular (legacy system), Scrum agile methodology.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Worked closely with the Lead Software Architect and Business Analyst to provide ad-hoc web applications. Developed new features and functionalities to improve and factorize the legacy code. Solved issues and defects reported by the customers. Refactored Classes and utility functions. Developed Unit Tests and  Functional Tests using PHPUnit Framework. Performed code reviews and quality assurance for my Team. Built, Modified and verified Stored Procedures on Mysql Database. Contributed to the planning of each Sprint for my work Team. Kept documented on Rally my assignments.

Applied Technologies: PHP 7 with Symfony3 MVC Framework, Test Driven Development (TDD), PHPUnit, Unit Tests, Functional Tests, Zend Framework for Legacy System, SaaS, Scrum agile methodology, PSR-4 Implementation, PHPStorm, GitHub version controller, Rally, MySql Database, MongoDB database JQuery, AJAX, JSON, Restful, Tcpdf library, Linux Ubuntu, Docker.

positions.title: PHP Developer
positions.description: Supported web applications for 3K+ travel agencies including both consumer-facing sites (B2C) and travel agent reservation system (B2B). Performed new development and enhancements of existing customer websites. Accomplished periodic maintenance of the PHP code solving issues and bugs reported by the customers. Maximized system integrity through troubleshooting and remediation of product defects. Identified and solved compatibility issues between API functionalities. Refactored Classes and utility functions. Accomplished migrations and rewriting of existing code in order to debug and update it to the latest PHP version. Performed code reviews and quality assurance for my Team. Modified and verified Store Procedures on Sybase Database. Contributed to the planning of each Sprint for my work Team. Kept up to date the documentation on JIRA of my assignments updating the Kanban board for each Sprint.

positions.title: PHP / MySQL Programmer
positions.description: Monitoring to third party developer and performing functionality tests in order to approve or refuse deliverable milestones of the project. Checking database structure, making suggestions to solve the issues and improve the design. Developed a small application with CodeIgniter PHP Framework to automate the searching information for call center. Performing SQL queries to get Leads from database. Analysis of obtained data in order to detect and filter duplicate Leads and fake information to prepare monthly reports. Developed app with Symfony2 Framework to parse XML reports gotten from Lead Capsule System and insert parsed Leads into Mysql Database to get handleable data. Design of Mysql Database structure and Model to develop a Marketing Campaigns Manager System with Symfony2 PHP Framework.

positions.title: PHP Web Developer
positions.locationName: Austin y alrededores, Texas, Estados Unidos · Remote
positions.description: Remote Consulting on Symfony2 MVC Framework for designing and programming of emails, invoices and bills templates with Twig tool. Analysis and reverse engineering of Web projects developed by third parties in PHP to evaluate its scalability and make improvements. Reviewing documentation and performing tests of Symfony2 CMF tool to build CMS applications. Programming of landing page front-end using Symfony2, Bootstrap CSS, HTML5 and Javascript tools.

positions.title: Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
positions.description:
Managed, led, and developed projects for my own IT Consulting Company that specialized on development of web-based intranet applications using LAMP stack technologies. Performed multiple roles according to the characteristics and requirements of each project and final customer.
Project Manager. Coordinate up to five projects simultaneously. Oversee five to ten software developers (onsite and remotely). Coordinate meetings with customers, agree on project objectives. Evaluate projects to determine methodology used. Carry out risk assessment. Determine activities, specific aims, milestones, and deliverables. Define Roles. Chose the appropriate human resources and tools to develop each project. Plan, distribute, and schedule tasks. Monitor sub-contractors to ensure guidelines are maintained. Guide the developer team to apply best practices in code writing. Assure that all the aims of the projects are met. Oversee accounting, costing and billing. Prepare presentations, Gantt and PERT-CPM chart.  
Senior Software Engineer and Web-Developer. Frontend and Backend developer programming in PHP MVC Frameworks such as Symfony 2 and CodeIgniter. Implement Ajax using JQuery libraries in order to improve user experience. Gather information and prepare documentation for technology transfer (UML diagrams, Use case diagrams, sequence diagrams, ER diagrams). Design and configure database architecture. Contribute in all phases of the development lifecycle. Troubleshoot, test and maintain the core product software and databases to ensure strong optimization and functionality. Write code following industry best practices. Documentation and factorization code. Develop and deploy new features to facilitate related procedures and tools if necessary.
Operations Manager. Tasks related to the management of an IT consulting company, such as sales representation, payments to vendors and sub-contractors, tax payments, personnel management, recruiting sub-contractors, advertising and marketing.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description: Remote consulting on Symfony2 PHP MVC Framework. Leading and developing large scale projects web-oriented programing in PHP y MySQL with MVC framework Symfony 2.5 and Doctrine. Analysis and reverse engineering of Web projects developed by third parties in PHP to evaluate its scalability and make improvements.

positions.title: Informatic Consultant
positions.description: Consultoría en informática desarrollando aplicaciones web administrativas y de automatización de procesos en PHP y PostgreSQL con framework MVC Symfony 2.3 y Doctrine. Elaboración de documentación para la transferencia tecnológica: Diagramas UML, Diagramas de secuencia, Diagramas de entidad-relación.

company.name: Vicepresidencia de la República Bolivariana de Venezuela

positions.title: External Consultant in Information Technologies
positions.description: Consultor Externo en informática, desarrollando aplicaciones administrativas y de automatización de procesos en PHP y PostgreSQL con framework MVC CodeIgniter 2.1. Elaboración de documentación para la transferencia tecnológica: Diagramas UML, Diagramas de secuencia, Diagramas de entidad-relación.

company.name: Ministerio del Poder Popular para Relaciones Exteriores

positions.title: Telecommunications Engineer II
positions.description: Performing tasks and activities related to cell planning AMPS/TDMA mobile network for expansion of existing cells and growth of new sites for Radio Base Stations (RBS), set up, drive test, transmission test, statistics analysis, traffic analysis for expansion of RBS, administration and frequencies distribution. Developing and programming applications to automate processes using MS Visual Basic.

positions.title: Developer Engineer
positions.description: Developing projects of Automation and control of Industrials Process. Control Systems and data acquisition (SCADA). Programming of Programmable Logic Controller (PLC). Development and programming applications in C/C++ for integration Systems.
